Salman Khan's plea over 'Kala Hiran' film deferred by Delhi High Court

The Delhi High Court has deferred a hearing on actor Salman Khan's plea concerning the film 'Kala Hiran'. The court was informed that the film has not yet been sent for censor board certification. The dispute involves Khan's personality rights and the film's content, with a producer reportedly assuring the court regarding the matter.
